clue.text: Mathematical function's old-fashioned origin

parts.note: square means stuffy and old-fashioned, out of touch
a root is a source or origin, as in the root of a problem

explanation.surface: A remark that some piece of maths has quaint, old-fashioned beginnings.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking the number which multiplied by itself gives a value is a standard mathematical operation.

clue.text: Shake Fletcher's case

explanation.surface: Someone called Fletcher is being shaken up by a legal case.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to shake; a fletcher makes arrows, and arrows are carried in this case.

clue.text: Everything on first person's viewing equipment is rubbish

parts.note: all means everything
my is the first person possessive
the eye is the organ we see with

explanation.surface: Someone's whole pair of glasses or binoculars is declared junk.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned exclamation meaning nonsense, as in 'that's all ___'.

clue.text: Raced eight furlongs uphill about to complete the heat

indicators.note: about means the outer letters go around the word to
in a down clue, going uphill means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: raced means ran
eight furlongs make one mile, written I (Roman one) plus MILE

explanation.surface: A racehorse ran a mile uphill and nearly finished the heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uphill' turns RAN I MILE into ELIMINAR; 'about' wraps that round TO. 'complete' just links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary race whose losers drop out is called a heat, or an eliminating round.

clue.text: Not one unctuous policeman on American mountain

indicators.note: not tells us to leave out what follows, here the one

parts.note: unctuous means oily, greasy
one is the Roman numeral I
MP is military police, a policeman

explanation.surface: A smarmy American policeman is described climbing a peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not one' removes I from OILY to leave OLY.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest peak in Greece, home of the gods in myth.

clue.text: Nothing unsatisfactory in that

indicators.note: in that word signals the letters are found inside the word Nothing

explanation.surface: A claim that nothing at all is wrong with something.
explanation.definitionFit: A weak or flimsy excuse is described as unconvincing in this way.

clue.text: Gun concealed in a roll causes panic

indicators.note: concealed in puts the gun word inside the following letters

parts.note: a roll is a list of names, as in a roll call
an arm is a weapon such as a gun

explanation.surface: A hidden firearm in a bundle sets off a scare.
explanation.definitionFit: A scaremonger is someone who spreads fear, so the word describes what stirs up fright.

clue.text: Break Susan's heart? Stranger's resolved to make a start

indicators.note: resolved, in the sense of broken down and settled anew, signals rearranging the letters
the heart of a five-letter name is its central letter

explanation.surface: A romantic drama: a stranger is determined to start breaking Susan's heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' rearranges STRANGERS to TRANSGRES; the centre letter of Susan, S, completes it. 'to make a start' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: To violate a law or rule is to break it, overstepping a limit.

clue.text: Lady's possessive about bird — a mistake

indicators.note: about means the possessive word goes round the bird

parts.note: her is the possessive used of a woman
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A woman's possessiveness over a bird turns out to be an error.
explanation.definitionFit: A glaring blunder, especially a laughable one, is called this.

clue.text: Wrong house, very small, with no opening

parts.note: a villa is a house

indicators.note: no opening means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: tiny means very small

explanation.surface: Something is amiss with a tiny house that has no door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no opening' removes T from TINY to leave INY. 'Wrong' is a noun here, wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicked conduct or wrongdoing is the nature of a scoundrel.

clue.text: Orange tongue

explanation.surface: A note about an orange tongue, perhaps after eating sweets.
explanation.definitionFit: A small citrus fruit like a tangerine; also the main language of China.

clue.text: Peg out right in box, perhaps

indicators.note: out, as in outside, means the peg word goes round right

parts.note: a tee is a small peg a golf ball sits on

explanation.surface: Instructions to stake out a box with pegs in the right place.
explanation.walkthrough: Box is a shrub, so it is an example of the answer; 'in' just links the parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Box is an evergreen shrub or small woody plant, an example of this.

clue.text: Fairy can edge some distance

parts.note: a tin is a can
a kerb is the edge of a pavement (British spelling)
an ell is an old measure of length

explanation.surface: A fairy manages to inch along a little way.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiny sprite in Peter Pan is named this.

clue.text: Revolting shrew about to handle a container

indicators.note: about means the shrew word goes round the rest

parts.note: a nag is a shrewish, scolding woman
to use is to handle
a tin is a container

explanation.surface: A nagging woman is about to pick up a jar, disgustingly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sickening or disgusting makes one feel queasy.

clue.text: Lucy upset a shift for Australian oil supplier

indicators.note: shift signals moving the letters about into a new order

explanation.surface: Lucy was annoyed by a work shift at an Australian oil company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'shift' is the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: The gum tree of Australia yields an aromatic medicinal oil.

clue.text: Book the young leaders — an unusual experience

parts.note: a novel is a book

indicators.note: leaders means the first letters of the next words

explanation.surface: A book about youthful leaders makes a change.
explanation.definitionFit: Something new and different, a fresh experience, is a novel thing.

clue.text: Contend with quarters of the city

parts.note: to vie is to contend or compete
quarters are compass points: N, N, E, S, E

explanation.surface: Coping with the different districts of a town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the city' here is Vienna; the compass points stand for quarters as directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to Vienna, the Austrian capital.

clue.text: Staff employed in the Royal Household

definitions.text: Staff employed in the Royal Household

parts.words: Staff employed in the Royal Household
parts.note: staff reads as servants at court, but it means a ceremonial rod held by the monarch

explanation.surface: A job advert for servants at the palace.
explanation.definitionFit: The ornamental rod carried by a monarch as an emblem of sovereignty.

clue.text: Turn one's nose up at a couple of bears

indicators.note: a couple of means the bear word appears twice

parts.note: Winnie-the-Pooh, the bear of A. A. Milne's stories

explanation.surface: Sniffing disdainfully at a pair of bears.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss scornfully, treat as beneath notice.

clue.text: Poles absorb French company — in France, it is common knowledge

indicators.note: absorb means the poles take in the company inside them

parts.note: the poles are south and north, S and N
Cie is the French abbreviation for company
ce is French for it

explanation.surface: North and South swallow a French firm, which everyone in France knows about.
explanation.definitionFit: Its original sense is knowing, from the Latin scientia, a body of learning.

clue.text: Charged with emotion, etc — I recall vaguely

indicators.note: vaguely suggests the letters of the words are put in a loose new order

explanation.surface: Someone half-remembers an emotionally charged moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tense, thrilling atmosphere is described as electric or electrifying.

clue.text: Give "Love Divine" a second chance

parts.note: love is zero, O in tennis scoring
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a divine
S is short for second

explanation.surface: A plea to give a hymn, Love Divine, another try.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Love Divine' is a well-known hymn; 'Give' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Probability or likelihood, as in what the chances are.

clue.text: This is routed a different, way

definitions.text: This is routed a different, way

indicators.note: a different way tells us to rearrange the letters of routed

explanation.surface: A road sign announces a diversion.
explanation.definitionFit: A diversion is a roundabout path taken instead of the usual one.

clue.text: Bad if one's misrepresented as genuine

indicators.note: misrepresented suggests the words are presented in a distorted new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Something bad being passed off as authentic.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for in good faith, meaning authentic or real.

clue.text: At the beginning of last month, it turned very cold

indicators.note: at the beginning puts the first letter of it at the front
turned means the month abbreviation is written backwards

parts.note: December, the last month of the year, is short Dec

explanation.surface: Weather report: early last month it became freezing.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen over or chilled with ice, so extremely chilly.

clue.text: Mediocre cooler

explanation.surface: An ordinary, unremarkable fridge.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means not very good, and literally less warm.

clue.text: Five years in glory

explanation.surface: Half a decade spent in triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: A lustrum is a five-year period, also spelt this way; and splendour or brilliant renown.

clue.text: Frock transposed for wear by men

indicators.note: transposed means the two halves of the frock's name swap places

parts.note: a shirtdress is a frock styled like a shirt

explanation.surface: A dress made over to be worn by men.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal top worn by men with evening dress.
